title: Augmentation comparisons give the same section homology map
statement: Let i be continuous between the Zariski and etale sites [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology], with additive exact abelian inverse image. Let I resolve F and R resolve i_*F [def-sp-injective-resolutions]. If chain maps a,b:R→i_*I agree with the pushed augmentation on R.ι in degree zero, then H^q(E_V(a)) = H^q(E_V(b)) for every degree q and open V. No quasi-isomorphism assumption on i_*I is made.

proof.text: Exact inverse image implies that its right adjoint preserves injectives. Put f=a-b. The augmentation equation says R.ι⁰ followed by f⁰ is zero. Exactness of R and injectivity of each target term construct a null homotopy inductively: h₀ factors f⁰ through d_R⁰; h₁ factors f¹-h₀d_K⁰; at the next step factor fⁿ⁺²-hₙ₊₁d_Kⁿ⁺¹ through d_Rⁿ⁺². The chain-map equation verifies the required vanishing. Thus a and b are homotopic. Additive evaluation preserves the homotopy, and Homotopy.homologyMap_eq proves equality. This proof is fully formalized in the module.

proof_origin.note: Resolution formula split into existence and independence; independence formalized by null-homotopy induction.

theorem zariski_etale_resolution_homology_independent
    {X : Scheme.{u + 1}}
    (i : X.Opens ⥤ X.Etale)
    (hi : i.IsContinuous (Opens.grothendieckTopology X.carrier)
      X.smallEtaleTopology)
    [HasSheafify (Opens.grothendieckTopology X.carrier) AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}]
    [HasSheafify X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}]
    [HasExt
      (Sheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology X.carrier) AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})]
    [HasExt (Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})]
    [(sheafPullback i AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}
      (Opens.grothendieckTopology X.carrier) X.smallEtaleTopology).Additive]
    [PreservesFiniteLimits (sheafPullback i AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}
      (Opens.grothendieckTopology X.carrier) X.smallEtaleTopology)]
    (F : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
    (I : InjectiveResolution F)
    (R : InjectiveResolution ((i.sheafPushforwardContinuous AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}
      (Opens.grothendieckTopology X.carrier) X.smallEtaleTopology).obj F))
    (a : R.cocomplex ⟶
      ((i.sheafPushforwardContinuous AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}
        (Opens.grothendieckTopology X.carrier) X.smallEtaleTopology).mapHomologicalComplex
          (ComplexShape.up ℕ)).obj I.cocomplex)
    (ha : R.ι.f 0 ≫ a.f 0 = (i.sheafPushforwardContinuous AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}
      (Opens.grothendieckTopology X.carrier) X.smallEtaleTopology).map (I.ι.f 0))
    (b : R.cocomplex ⟶
      ((i.sheafPushforwardContinuous AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}
        (Opens.grothendieckTopology X.carrier) X.smallEtaleTopology).mapHomologicalComplex
          (ComplexShape.up ℕ)).obj I.cocomplex)
    (hb : R.ι.f 0 ≫ b.f 0 = (i.sheafPushforwardContinuous AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}
      (Opens.grothendieckTopology X.carrier) X.smallEtaleTopology).map (I.ι.f 0))
    (q : ℕ) (V : X.Opens) :
    (HomologicalComplex.homologyMap
          (((sheafToPresheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology X.carrier) AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} ⋙
            (evaluation X.Opensᵒᵖ AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}).obj (op V)).mapHomologicalComplex
               (ComplexShape.up ℕ)).map a) q) =
      (HomologicalComplex.homologyMap
          (((sheafToPresheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology X.carrier) AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} ⋙
            (evaluation X.Opensᵒᵖ AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}).obj (op V)).mapHomologicalComplex
               (ComplexShape.up ℕ)).map b) q)
